obligations.reason: v16 specifies threeCores, defaultInstall, and inventorySchema. Remainder of this specified inventory/graph is measurement at the already-named G01-G05 identifiers. This join does not retarget those namings. It does not claim OBL-2 harness specifications are authored.

The five harness identifiers are named and not authored. D-056 turn-2 Decision clause 5: authoring fixtures and harness specifications remains design work; execution remains qualification. OBL-2 stays leftover-design until independently reviewed G01-G05 harness specifications exist. Naming is not authoring. This join does not invent those specifications.
v16 inventorySchema.everyReleaseMustPublish is specified. Qualitative TCB identity remains DR-126 / G22 (v16 ID-DEP-K2). This join does not retarget G22.
v16 inventorySchema.layerTaxonomy and graphRules specify layering. Remainder is published-inventory measurement at the named core gates.

Core implementation language is RESERVED on v16. G01-G05 measure size, startup, memory, and component delta. They do not own a language choice. G13 is language-quality for supported analyzer roles, not core-language selection. This join does not mint Rust-as-core.

v16 extracts signing ROLES and reserves ceremony/thresholds/notarization. G01-G05 do not own OS notarization or code-signing ceremony. DR-112 recovery ceremony and DR-110 repair-media trust remain adjacent, not owners.
v16 platforms are specified as the D-002 four-platform set. Remainder is per-platform measurement at the named identifiers. This join does not change D-002 platforms.
